corrections.reason: Visually on the page and philologically across the column wrap into Col 2 L01 (ጡ), the phrase is 'አለቆች በጡጡ በሰንበ ጠለፍ ነድፈው ያናግሩህ የለምን' ('will not the rulers interrogate you, striking you with cords and whips?').
The third character is 'ድ' (ነድፈው, 'striking/stinging with a whip'), which was misread as 'ር'.
Canonical Ge'ez Gospel text (John 9:14) and visual inspection show 1st-order 'ተ' (ወከሠተ አዕይንቲሁ), not 7th-order 'ቶ'.

corrections.old_text: ው ። ቢጋሩ ያለ ነው ቢሉ እ
corrections.corrected_text: ው ። ቢጋሩ ዖለ ነው ቢሉ እ
corrections.reason: In the traditional Andemta discussion of the man born blind, 'ዖለ' (hollow/eyeless socket) is the technical term printed here, visually 'ዖለ' rather than 'ያለ'.
Joining with 'ት' at the start of Col 3 L10 forms 'በማለት' ('by saying'); the printed glyphs at the end of L09 are clearly 'በማለ'.
